_comment: Gardien-chef Vorhan's music (a Défi board boss), played by our own sound engine as music: the game's own
music silent meanwhile. PrisonIdle while the player looks at the boss's page on the board, WardenVorhan for the
fight. Each file is its track's intro then exactly one loop period, cut sample-exact from the composer's file
(which repeats it): the engine goes back to loopStart (a frame) at the end, seamlessly.
